verdict.rationale: Grafana documents connecting AI agents through a hosted Cloud MCP Server or a self-managed open source MCP Server, and a probe confirms an official MCP server repo and an OpenAPI spec. Grafana itself is documented to query metrics, logs, and traces. However, the evidence never says these agent-facing APIs actually expose metric, log, and trace queries for production debugging, so coverage is partial. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that the MCP server or API supports querying metrics (PromQL), logs (LogQL), and traces (Tempo); hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent debugging production through these APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an external agent query metrics, logs, and traces through documented APIs to debug production

citations.quote: Connect AI agents to Grafana through the fully hosted Cloud MCP Server or the self-managed open source MCP Server.
official MCP server documented at https://github.com/grafana/mcp-grafana
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://grafana.com/api/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
enables you to query, visualize, alert on, and explore your metrics, logs, and traces wherever they're stored
